verdict.rationale: A state business registry could plausibly offer exports of a filer's records in open formats, so the axis applies. However, the evidence shows only adjacent features. CCFS Search, Certificates and Certified Copies, and Voluntary Business Closure cover record lookup, purchasing certified documents, and dissolving an entity. None documents a self-service export of all of a user's data in open, machine-readable formats.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
